name: Lawrence Hanson
source:
"Welcome to St. Lucia. Do your job, and don't cause me trouble."

Subject - World history.

A cold teacher who is seen by many as rude.
His professional reputation is impeccable and often envied by others. However, his personal life doesn't seem to follow the same style.
Rumors around the school hall are starting to question who he is.
